lines.text: Jashobeam son of Hachmoni, chief of the officers, wielded his spear against three hundred men and killed them.
When the troops fled the Philistines, Eleazar and David defended the barley field, and the LORD brought a great victory.
David longed for water from the well near the gate of Hebron, but poured it out to the LORD.
Abishai, Joab's brother, wielded his spear against three hundred men and commanded the Three without being included among them.
Benaiah struck down two champions of Edom, killed a lion in a pit, and David appointed him over his guard.
